title: Some items were missing
text: I'm not too big on subscription boxes but heard the January box had some things that would interest me, like the face oil. However, I didn't receive all the items advertised: I didn't get the lip crayon or the shadow stick, and I certainly would have liked to have tried the latter. I did receive a nail polish which might have been meant as a replacement for one item, but I don't think it should count as a replacement for two. In the end, I wouldn't recommend it if some boxes are short-changed compared to others.
label: neutral
